subject: Coffee @RSNA [YEAR]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given your focus on medical imaging, expect you'll be at RSNA in two weeks? We work with Flatiron Health, Viz.ai and Highmark Health to improve DICOM/NIfTI annotation quality - would love to connect over a coffee at the conference.

A key problem we solve with Radiology AI teams is to coordinate multi-reader annotation and QC across ML engineers and clinical experts. We address this with built-in consensus/adjudication workflows, structured review stages, and role-based access controls. Our hierarchical ontology builder ensures consistent, context-rich labelling across studies.

Would be great to exchange perspectives over a coffee. We'll be at RSNA Sunday (11/30) to Tuesday (12/2) - how's your schedule looking Monday afternoon?

subject: Automating Annotation Tasks
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed you're gearing up your perception team to automate annotation, so I
thought now might be a good time to connect. We work with Nexar, Motive,
and Woven (Toyota), which, similar to [COMPANY], train their models from
vehicle-mounted camera data.

A typical challenge for those teams is to accelerate iteration speed when
prototyping new model capabilities. We solve this by integrating data
curation and annotation - so teams can find rare events, run through a
model for autolabel, and send human review for label quality in one place.

How are you thinking about the data flywheel at Hayden? I'm free Thursday
morning to connect.

subject: Evaluate Encord?
text:
Hi [NAME],

As Labelbox has shifted more toward BPO services and less toward core
platform development, we've seen a number of teams move over to Encord for
stronger data curation, annotation, and model-eval workflows.

We've continued to invest heavily in the software platform most recently
releasing [SENDER] 3 inside Encord. For See & Spray type workloads, [SENDER] 3 can
dramatically accelerate pre-labeling for plants, weeds, soil, and shadows,
producing cleaner segmentation masks with far less manual work.

Better masks creates more reliable spray decisions in production,
especially for early-growth weeds where accuracy matters most.

Would you be open to connecting briefly next week to share a quick overview
and see if it's relevant ahead of your renewal?
